# Jofre Oliveras

> Jofre Oliveras (Girona, Spain, 1989) is a transnational artist, artistic director and
> project manager working at the intersection of public-space art, ecology and technology.
> jofrearchive.com is his working archive: research-driven projects documented as studies,
> objects and public interventions. Founder of Persona Archive; artistic director of the
> Underline Public Art Festival (Amman, Beirut, Barcelona).

## Sections
- [Archive (home)](https://jofrearchive.com/): entry point to the full body of work
- [Studies](https://jofrearchive.com/studies/): research projects and open investigations
- [Gallery](https://jofrearchive.com/gallery/): objects and sculptural records
- [Urban Art Map](https://jofrearchive.com/map/): murals and site-specific public interventions
- [Genealogy](https://jofrearchive.com/genealogy/): documents and supporting records

## Key research projects
- Biomimetic Solar (2025): solar panels made from organic and regenerative materials through
  biomimetic design and DIY production methods; explores decentralised, ecologically embedded
  energy technologies.
- Interspecies Archaeology (2025): an archive for non-human agency — relics grown, eroded and
  indexed as if they were evidence.
- Dialogue Between Civilizations (2025): an atomic pyramid built from gold atoms, translating
  the geometric proportions of the pyramids of Giza into nanoscale structures; a dialogue
  between ancient architecture and contemporary nanotechnology.
- Fossil Synths: electronic sculpture and PCB-based instruments inspired by fossils and
  natural forms.

## About
- Artist, artistic director and project manager based between Spain and international projects.
- Focus: public art, ecology, biotechnology, sustainability, activism and humanitarian action.
- Studies in Cultural Communication (Philosophy and Art), University of Girona.
- Contact and full profile: https://jofrearchive.com/
